concept: CloudFront: caching S3 content at the edge
tests: How to reduce latency when serving large files from S3 to users worldwide.
expected: Amazon CloudFront with the S3 bucket as origin — cached at edge locations close to users. Triggers: "users worldwide", "high latency", "serve/download".
why_not: S3 Transfer Acceleration speeds up uploads to S3, not delivery; moving the bucket just shifts the latency; CRR to every Region is expensive and needs routing.
